programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The three adjacent colors on the top row define left, center, and right tracks.
    top = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v != 0 for v in row) >= 3)
    anchors = [(c, grid[top][c]) for c, v in enumerate(grid[top]) if v != 0]
    # For each outer track, connect its top cell to the isolated matching endpoint.
    for c, color in (anchors[0], anchors[-1]):
        points = [(r, x) for r in range(h) for x in range(w) if grid[r][x] == color and (r, x) != (top, c)]
        if points:
            r, x = points[0]
            for y in range(min(top, r), max(top, r) + 1):
                out[y][c] = color
            for xx in range(min(c, x), max(c, x) + 1):
                out[r][xx] = color
    # The middle color runs the full height.
    c, color = anchors[len(anchors)//2]
    for r in range(h):
        out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
